company.name: Aligned Surveyors
company.description: Established in 2017, Aligned Surveyors is a premier engineering surveying consultancy firm registered with the Zimbabwe Institute of Geomatics (ZIG) and the ZICT division of the Zimbabwe Institute of Engineers (ZIE). We specialize in delivering high-precision spatial solutions, infrastructure planning, and field arrays tailored to the demanding requirements of property developers, civil engineers, architects, and mine operators throughout the region.

team.name: Mr. K.K. Nyandoro
team.bio: A pioneering professional trained at the University of Zimbabwe with active field tenure dating back to 2012. Offers more than 8 years of specialized regional experience executing both simple and highly complex topographical, infrastructural, and engineering arrays across Zimbabwe and the SADC region (including Namibia).

team.name: Mr. H. Mutandi
team.bio: Holds a BSc Honors Degree in Surveying and Geomatics from MSU. Brings 9 years of diverse, multi-cultural operational experience managing technical field survey deployments across Zimbabwe, Zambia, and Sudan.

team.name: Mr. R. Nyoni
team.bio: Graduated with a BSc Honors Degree in Surveying and Geomatics from MSU in 2016. Leverages 6 years of focused technical expertise inside the road and building construction industries, supported by an advanced knowledge of top-tier hardware systems and South African spatial architectures.

team.name: Mr. O.S. Mtetwa
team.bio: A 2016 graduate with a BSc in Surveying and Geoinformatics from UZ. Accumulates 5 years of field operational experience across South Africa, Namibia, and Zimbabwe, with specific mastery in engineering, volumetric computation, topographical mappings, and modern UAV/Drone imagery workflows.

team.name: Mr. T. Gondo
team.bio: A dedicated Geomatics surveyor holding a BSc Honors in Surveying and Geoinformatics from UZ (2016). Offers 6 years of industry expertise across bulk earthworks, reticulation, road engineering, and GIS mapping systems, while finalizing an MSc in Geomatics Engineering at the University of Zimbabwe.

team.name: Ms. B.T. Nemaramba
team.bio: An energetic, highly motivated mining professional holding a National Diploma from the Zimbabwe School of Mines along with a BSc Honors from Bindura University. Highly skilled in managing intensive underground and open-pit mine development layouts, statistical data controls, and technical research applications.
